subtype: spec-conflict (design-doc purpose vs settled design decision and stories)
severity: potential-low (carried by ECON-001; do not double-count)
specText: src/CLAUDE.md Purpose: "A claim therefore has positive expected value whenever `market value of the yield tokens - discounted USDC payment > gas + NFT cost`."  versus  src/CLAUDE.md settled 'Gas check' bullet, story-003 Acceptance "The gas check reverts `Unprofitable` when `ethOut < (gasUsedSoFar + GAS_OVERHEAD) * tx.gasprice`" and story-005 Overview "Derives a `minEthOut` that guarantees the gas is covered."
specSource: src/CLAUDE.md (Purpose + Design decisions); story-003 doc Acceptance; story-005 doc Story Overview step 4 / Technical Details step 4
actualBehavior: Both gates price only gas. The on-chain check is (g0-gasleft+60k)*tx.gasprice. The script floor is gasLimit*maxFee+MIN_PROFIT_WEI, with MIN_PROFIT_WEI defaulting to 0. Neither prices the claim-NFT unit that SYA burns. Story-005's own Anvil 'profitable' case reports success after burning NFT index 1 (mint price ~10.78 USDC) for a net of ~0.00365 ETH (~8.5 USD).
deviation: The code faithfully implements stories 003 and 005, and the stories faithfully implement the settled Gas-check decision. Only the CLAUDE.md Purpose invariant ('> gas + NFT cost') fails to hold. The project spec contradicts itself: the purpose names NFT cost, while every lower-level spec (design decision, story-003, story-005, README) names only gas. This is a spec-level gap, not an implementation slip.
law1Assessment: Not story-unsafe under Law 1. The loss is the operator's own (at most one NFT per tx), no third party extracts value and the protocol is not harmed. Severity stays with ECON-001.
recommendation: Owner to reconcile the spec. Either amend story-005, or add a follow-up story, so the floor includes NFTMinterV2.getPrice(nftIndex) converted to ETH (or so MIN_PROFIT_WEI must be set at least that high), or reword the CLAUDE.md Purpose. Until then the README should state that MIN_PROFIT_WEI must cover the NFT's value.
label: F-01
note: Faithfulness cross-ref carried on its parent finding; not a separate ledger entry (not double-counted). Must appear in submissions/spec-conformance.md.
